# Capri Destination Management Company (Capri DMC) — Complete B2B Dossier

## Overview & Profile
- Name: Capri Destination Management Company (Capri DMC)
- Legal Lineage: Spin-off from Nesea Capri Tours & Events (operating on Capri since 2010)
- Corporate Structure: 100% Women-Owned Enterprise
- Founding Team:
  - Giusy Perrotta: Co-Founder & Director of Operations (Native Caprese, 15+ years maritime and concierge mastery)
  - Melania Esposito: Co-Founder & Head of Event Production (Specialist in historic villa weddings & milestone celebrations)
  - Roberta De Martino: Co-Founder & Lead Cultural Curator (Licensed art historian & island heritage researcher)
- Location: 80076 Capri, Metropolitan City of Naples, Campania, Italy (40.5507° N, 14.2426° E)
- Hours: 24 Hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7 Island Ground Operations)
- Primary Email: partnerships@capridmc.com
- 24/7 Advisor Phone / WhatsApp: +39 333 594 3947
- Direct 24/7 WhatsApp Link: https://wa.me/393335943947

## Core Mottos & Brand Identity
- "From Capri for Capri"
- "Your Roots in Capri"

Capri DMC was engineered specifically to solve the friction, opacity, and time-zone delays global luxury travel advisors experience when planning trips to Capri. By remaining 100% on-island and native, we eliminate third-party mainland markups and provide real-time WhatsApp dispatch.

## Comprehensive Service Catalog (11 Master B2B Offerings)

### 1. Capri Private Boat Tours & Gozzo Charters
- Cluster: Exclusive Solutions
- Subtitle: Traditional Gozzo Caprese, Riva Speedboats & Luxury Yacht Charters
- Category Badge: Maritime Flagship
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Guaranteed Fleet Availability
- Detailed Description: Through our unmatched on-island maritime network, Capri DMC provides luxury travel advisors with priority access to Capri's premier wooden gozzo boats, high-speed Riva yachts, and chartered catamarans. Even during peak July and August demand, our native licensed skippers navigate secret grottoes, Faraglioni passages, and secluded swimming coves with chilled champagne and tailored catering.
- Key B2B Operational Features:
  * Secured peak-season availability for traditional Gozzo Caprese & modern yachts
  * Faraglioni arch navigation & private Blue Grotto dawn protocol
  * Chilled champagne, prosecco, local fruit & towel service onboard
  * Flexible pick-up: Marina Grande, Marina Piccola, or private hotel tender docks

### 2. Transfers, Check-In & Ticketing Services
- Cluster: Exclusive Solutions
- Subtitle: Airport-to-Suite Logistics, Open-Top Capri Taxis & Luggage Command
- Category Badge: Turnkey Logistics
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Frictionless Turnkey Arrival
- Detailed Description: From the second your VIP clients land at Naples Capodichino (NAP) or Rome Fiumicino (FCO), Capri DMC assumes complete logistical command. We orchestrate tarmac Mercedes-Maybach transfers, private maritime crossings, custom open-air convertible Capri taxis, and dedicated luggage porterage directly into 5-star hotel suites with zero lobby delay.
- Key B2B Operational Features:
  * VIP tarmac meet & greet at Naples (NAP) and Rome (FCO) airports
  * Direct luggage dispatch: bags delivered inside suites prior to check-in
  * Iconic Capri open-top convertible taxis & private island bus charters
  * VIP priority ticketing for island funicular, chairlifts, and archaeological sites

### 3. Dedicated 24/7 Island Conciergerie

Our dedicated concierge team secures highly contested reservations at Capri's most sought-after cliffside restaurants (La Fontelina, Da Paolino, Il Riccio, Aurora), reserves VIP daybeds at premier beach clubs, coordinates private helicopter flights, and provides immediate emergency re-routing.
- Key B2B Operational Features:
  * Priority reservations at premier cliffside dining venues & private beach clubs

### 5. Exclusive Guided Island Tours
- Cluster: Custom Experiences
- Subtitle: Privileged Access Led by Certified Native Capresi Guides
- Category Badge: Heritage & Culture
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Beyond Standard Tourism
- Detailed Description: Crafted exclusively for high-net-worth travelers, our private guided walking and cultural tours reveal the authentic soul of Capri and Anacapri. Led by certified resident art historians and native guides (the Nesea Capri founders team), guests bypass commercial queues to discover hidden courtyards, Roman imperial villas (Villa Jovis, Villa Damecuta), and private botanical terraces.
- Key B2B Operational Features:
  * Bespoke itineraries tailored to VIP client interests, art, and history
  * After-hours private access to Villa Lysis, Villa San Michele, and historic convents
  * Fluent multilingual guides: English, Italian, French, Spanish, German
  * Seamless integration with open-top taxi transfers and private refreshment stops

### 7. Private Cooking Classes in Authentic Caprese Homes
- Cluster: Custom Experiences

Guided by native home cooks and sommeliers, your guests learn the secrets of traditional Ravioli Capresi, fresh handmade pasta, sea bass al cartoccio, Caprese chocolate cake, and authentic Limoncello crafted from freshly harvested organic island lemons.

### 9. Hidden Hiking Excursions & Secret Nature Routes
- Cluster: Custom Experiences
- Subtitle: Pristine Trails Far Removed from Mass Commercial Footfall
- Category Badge: Active Wilderness
- B2B Advisor Advantage: Untouched Island Wilderness

From the dramatic Sentiero dei Fortini coastal trail to Mount Solaro ridges, ancient hermitages, and secret sea lookouts, our naturalist guides provide an exclusive encounter with Capri's raw Mediterranean wilderness.
- Key B2B Operational Features:

  * Private cliffside gourmet picnics with local wines and panoramic views
  * Option to combine coastal hiking with private speedboat return pick-up

## VIP Logistics Architecture: From Airport to 5★ Suite
1. Tarmac VIP Meet & Greet: Dedicated personal escort at the aircraft gate at Naples Capodichino (NAP) or Rome Fiumicino (FCO), fast-track luggage retrieval, private Mercedes-Maybach limousine transfer to marina or helipad.
2. Private Maritime Crossing: Direct private Riva speedboat crossing (bypassing commercial ferries) or chartered helicopter flight directly to Capri Damecuta helipad.
3. Island Porterage & Iconic Open-Top Taxi: Dedicated porters handle all luggage at the dock while guests step into custom open-top convertible Capri taxis.
4. Direct-to-Suite Room Placement: Luggage is unpacked and placed inside 5-star hotel suites prior to guest arrival with zero lobby waiting.

## Destination Weddings, Bar Mitzvahs & Milestone Celebrations
- Historic Cliffside Villa Buyouts: Exclusive access to private estates overlooking the Faraglioni and the Gulf of Naples.
- Jewish Lifecycle Celebrations: Bar Mitzvah and Bat Mitzvah ceremonies with scenic Torah readings overlooking the Mediterranean, Shabbat dinners, and Kosher catering coordination.
- Turnkey Event Production: High-fashion floral styling, Michelin-starred culinary direction, dynamic sound/lighting, and multilingual on-site event directors.

## B2B Travel Advisor Advantages
- 100% On-Island Team with direct municipal port, hotelier, and maritime authority permits.
- Protected commission structures and transparent wholesale net rates.
